name: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky
subtitle: Stand assignment and push control for the terminal and the Amazon and DHL cargo ramps
source: CVG Amazon, CVG DHL and CVG terminal (Concourses A/B) ramp charts (user-supplied). x,y are pixels on the named chart, north up. Amazon and terminal lat/lon are derived from its evenly spaced grid (approximate). DHL lat/lon stay null until the OSM import or the stand editor. hdg/pushTo come from the chart lead-in lines; null means unclear. taxiOut marks stands that can also taxi straight out. maxCode is unused for now: aircraft size checks are deferred. A stand's optional label is its chart name when two ramps share one (Concourse A 'A10' is stand T-A10; Amazon keeps A10).

AZN.name: CVG Amazon Ramp
AZN.note: Evenly gridded (~112 px per 0.1' lat, ~84 px per 0.1' lon, ~1.7 m/px both ways), so stand lat/lon are derived from x,y. Expect +/- ~20 m; the stand editor refines them.

DHL.name: CVG DHL Ramp
DHL.note: Chart is not to scale between grid lines (lat spacing varies ~103-113 px per 0.1'); interpolate piecewise and treat as approximate.

PAX.name: CVG Terminal / Concourses A-B
PAX.note: Evenly gridded (~95 px per 0.1' lon, ~122 px per 0.1' lat, ~1.52 m/px both ways); RWY 18C/36C and 18L/36R edges land within ~10 m of published. Stand x,y are at the aircraft, read off the lead-in lines.

positions.name: DHL Ramp Control
positions.note: 130.375 is N taxilane control, worked by DHL Ramp. It links the Amazon spots (71-74) and the DHL spots on N.

positions.name: Ramp Control
positions.note: Ramp 1N, 1S, 2N and 2S taxilanes are 130.9. Ramp 3 taxilane (south of Concourse B) is 130.375, the same frequency as N taxilane on the cargo side.

airlinesSource: Terminal split from cvgairport.com and airport guides: Concourse B is Delta and Delta Connection; Concourse A has American, United, Southwest, Frontier, Allegiant, Alaska, Air Canada, Breeze and the other carriers. Cargo parks by operator (DHL by callsign, Amazon by OPR/AMAZON in remarks); ABX, ATN, GTI and other carriers flying for both need the remarks to tell which ramp. Remote parking is not given out automatically.
